title: Herbert Street Reconstruction
body:
Introduction
Welcome to the project page for the planned reconstruction of Herbert Street from Union to Pine Street. The City of Waterloo, together with the City of Kitchener, will reconstruct Herbert Street to replace the aged watermain, sewers and road structure (i.e. sidewalk, curbs and asphalt). This will also include the replacement of water and sanitary service laterals (pipes) up to the common property line.
Follow this page for updates and information regarding the project work. Typically, major notices and updates will be posted here as well as included in hard copy notices delivered directly to affected residents/owners (not the broader affected neighbourhood). Minor updates during construction may be posted on Engage Waterloo only. Subscribe to follow this project by providing your email address to receive updates as they become available.
